questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Bigg|_{(1,\frac{1}{3})}&=\frac{y}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}y^{2}}}\Bigg|_{(1,\frac{1}{3})}=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\ ,\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\Bigg|_{(1,\frac{1}{3})}=\frac{x}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}y^{2}}}\Bigg|_{(1,\frac{1}{3})}=\frac{3}{2\sqrt{2}}\ ,\\\text{沿 }x\text{ 轴方向的转角为 }0\ ,\text{ 则方向导数为：}\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}f(x,y)=x+y-\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\text{在点}(3,4)\text{沿}\vec{a}=(-4,3)\text{方向的方向导数是}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial f}{\partial x} \Bigg | _ {(3, 4)} = 1 - \frac {x}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \Bigg | _ {(3, 4)} = \frac {2}{5}, \frac {\partial f}{\partial y} \Bigg | _ {(3, 4)} = 1 - \frac {y}{\sqrt {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}} \Bigg | _ {(3, 4)} = \frac {1}{5}, \\ \text {沿} \bar {a} = (- 4, 3) \text {方向的转角的正，余弦为：} \cos \alpha = - \frac {4}{5}, \sin \alpha = \frac {3}{5} \\ \text {故方向导数为：} \frac {\partial f}{\partial \bar {a}} \Bigg | _ {(3, 4)} = - \frac {8}{25} + \frac {3}{25} = - \frac {1}{5}. \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}u=xy^{2}+z^{3}-xyz\text{在点}(1,1,2)\text{处沿着方向角为}\alpha=\frac{\pi}{3},\ \beta=\frac{\pi}{4},\ \gamma=\frac{\pi}{3} \text{方向的方向导数为}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,1,2)}&=-1,\ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,1,2)}=0,\ \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\bigg|_{(1,1,2)}=11\\&\cos \alpha=\frac{1}{2},\ \cos \beta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\ \cos \gamma=\frac{1}{2}\\&\text{于是}\ \frac{\partial u}{\partial l}\bigg|_{(1,1,2)}=(-1)\cdot \frac{1}{2}+0\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}+11\cdot \frac{1}{2}=5\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}z=x^{y}\text{在点}(1,2)\text{沿}\vec{a}=(1,1)\text{方向的方向导数是}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(1,2)}=yx^{y-1}\bigg|_{(1,2)}=2\ ,\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(1,2)}=x^y\ln x\bigg|_{(1,2)}=0\ ,\\&\text{沿}\ \ \vec{a}=(1,1)\text{方向的转角为}\ \varphi=\frac{\pi}{4}\ ,\\&\text{则方向导数为：}\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial \vec{a}}=2\cos\frac{\pi}{4}+0\sin\frac{\pi}{4}=\sqrt{2}\ .\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{函数}z=xy^{2}\text{在点}(1,2)\text{沿}\vec{a}=(1,1)\text{方向的方向导数是}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\Bigg|_{(1,2)}=y^{2}\Bigg|_{(1,2)}=4,\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\Bigg|_{(1,2)}=2xy\Bigg|_{(1,2)}=4\text{，由于沿}\vec{a}=(1,1)\text{方向，则转角}\varphi=\frac{\pi}{4}\text{，则}\frac{\partial z}{\partial \vec{a}}=4\cos\frac{\pi}{4}+4\sin\frac{\pi}{4}=4\sqrt{2}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{方法一：由}f(x,y)=\arctan\frac{x}{y}\text{知}\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=\frac{\frac{1}{y}}{1+(\frac{x}{y})^{2}}\bigg|_{(0,1)}=1,\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=\frac{-\frac{x}{y^{2}}}{1+(\frac{x}{y})^{2}}\bigg|_{(0,1)}=0\,,\\&\text{所以}gradf(0,1)=\vec{i}\,.\\&\text{方法二：由}f(x,y)=\arctan\frac{x}{y}\text{知}\\&\quad\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=\frac{d}{dx}f(x,1)\bigg|_{x=0}=\frac{d}{dx}\arctan x\bigg|_{x=0}=\frac{1}{1+x^{2}}\bigg|_{x=0}=1\\&\quad\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=\frac{d}{dy}f(0,y)\bigg|_{y=1}=0\\&\text{所以}gradf(0,1)=\vec{i}\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{求函数}z=\int_{0}^{x}e^{v^{2}+t^{2}}dt\text{在点}(0,0)\text{处沿}\overrightarrow{l}=(-1,2)\text{方向的方向导数}( ).
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=e^{x^2+y^2}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=1\,;\\&\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=\Big(2ye^{y^2}\int_0^x e^t dt\Big)\bigg|_{(0,0)}=0\,;\\&\text{又}\cos\alpha=\frac{-1}{\sqrt{5}}\,,\,\sin\alpha=\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\,,\,\text{则}\frac{\partial z}{\partial l}=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}.\end{aligned}
